question: Does deterministic reading-order reconciliation (layer-interleave fold plus geometry-order re-emit) close the ordering residue without harming healthy pages?

challenger_v6.identity: omp_toolbelt6 = omp_toolbelt5 + reorder pass (v6.0 trigger: bag >= 0.70, seq <= 0.75, gain >= 0.10, no layer gate)

runs.smoke: toolbelt6-mthv2-smoke4-v1 (4/4 sealed; GL-1054 pages 0.2705->0.7872 and 0.3848->0.7000; control untouched; mth1000-006 triggered against the declared expectation - preflight amendment recorded BEFORE the full run)

deterministic_sequence_recall.damage_note: Both damaged pages kept full content (bag vs gold 0.9701 and 0.9618) - pure ordering damage from adopting geometry order on pages whose annotation order geometry cannot explain.

judged_answer_recovery.note: The dip concentrates on the reordered trio (0.982->0.950, 0.950->0.880, 0.970->0.820): the order-tolerant judge already forgave the scrambled drafts and reads reorder fragment boundaries as noise. The two lenses now disagree about reordering: sequence (and the printed edition's reading order) favors it, the judge is indifferent-to-negative. One gateway-failed judgment purged and re-judged; zero failed rows in the artifact.

observations.discriminator_found: All five live adoptions split perfectly on the page-level two_layer flag: three wins are two_layer=true (the interleave class the pass was designed for), both casualties are two_layer=false single-layer pages. The damaging adoption also ended at sequence 0.700 against the reader channel while every healthy adoption ended >= 0.81.

gates.smoke_reorder_behavior: pass under the recorded pre-full-run amendment (mth1000-006 adopted, recall-neutral)
gates.full_recall: FAIL (mean 0.8546 < 0.87; other-21 delta -0.043 exceeds the 0.01 allowance)
gates.judged_non_regression: FAIL (0.9664 vs 0.9771 in-run, attributable to reordered pages)

decision: rejected as-is; v5 remains development champion
decision_detail: The pass proves its designed capability - the interleave trio lifts 0.28/0.49/0.74 to 0.83/0.73/0.86 sequence recall, the largest single-page gains of the campaign - but v6.0's trigger fired on two single-layer pages whose annotation order geometry cannot explain, converting good session drafts into geometry order and cancelling the mean. The evidence names the gold-free fix exactly: gate adoption on two_layer=true and raise the adoption floor to final sequence >= 0.75 against the reader channel. Both were applied to the module after the run as v6.1 (module sha256 7809f19a863e84bd4609b75087042148c9d65393d70046024a9a3ef7a033a746) and validated by replay: the damaged pages no longer adopt, GL-1054-1-12 and GL-1047-1-5 still lift, GL-1054-1-13 adopts only when its session clears the floor (it did in the live run at 0.810). The judged-lens dip on reordered pages is recorded as a watch item: fragment placement may need smoothing if the judge penalty persists under v6.1.
next_permitted_action: Render the v6.1 candidate from the updated module and run the paired smoke (trio plus both damaged pages plus control) under a fresh preflight; promote nothing from this evidence.
